title: ⚡ THE STORM HAS ARRIVED — VAJRA ENTERS THE TRINETRA UNIVERSE
text: A new storm has awakened in Kashi. Atharv Shukla is only 16—a brilliant engineering prodigy whose desperate attempt to save his police officer father brings him into contact with the ancient Trinetra Fragment. The relic bonds with his neural network and awakens Vajra, the Heir of Storms. Golden and cyan lightning, tactical genius and an ancient divine power now enter the Trinetra Universe.

title: Meet Vajra — the Heir of Storms
text: The official Vajra character profile is now live, introducing Atharv Shukla, Inspector Saurabh Shukla, the Trinetra Fragment, Vajra’s powers, abilities, weaknesses and origin.

title: Agniveer has arrived
text: A new hero has entered the Trinetra Universe. Aarav Rathore, the fiery guardian of Lucknow, now joins the growing roster as Agniveer.

title: Meet Agniveer — the blazing guardian of Lucknow
text: The official Agniveer character profile is now live, revealing Aarav Rathore, the Divine Trishul Core, Agni-Lok, his powers, weapons and weaknesses.

title: The official Trinetra Comics website is live
text: Welcome to the online home of the Trinetra Universe. Explore its heroes, mythology and growing world.

title: The Trinetra hero roster expands
text: Dedicated hero profiles are being developed as the Trinetra Universe grows beyond its first guardians.
